basic.name: Spectrum Beam
basic.description_template: Deals Fire DMG equal to {{value}}% of Asta's ATK to a single enemy.

skill.name: Meteor Storm
skill.description_template: Deals Fire DMG equal to {{initial_damage}}% of Asta's ATK to a single enemy and further deals DMG for 4 extra times, with each time dealing Fire DMG equal to {{subsequent_damage}}% of Asta's ATK to a random enemy.

ultimate.name: Astral Blessing
ultimate.description_template: Increases SPD of all allies by {{speed}} for 2 turn(s).

talent.name: Astrometry
talent.description_template:
Gains 1 stack of Charging for every different enemy hit by Asta plus an extra stack if the enemy hit has Fire Weakness.
For every stack of Charging Asta has, all allies' ATK increases by {{atk_buff}}%, up to 5 time(s).
Starting from her second turn, Asta's Charging stack count is reduced by 3 at the beginning of every turn.

technique.name: Miracle Flash
technique.description: Immediately attacks the enemy. After entering battle, deals Fire DMG equal to 50% of Asta's ATK to all enemies.

2.name: Sparks
2.description:
Asta's Basic ATK has a 80% base chance to Burn the enemy target for 3 turn(s).
Burned enemies take Fire DoT equal to 50% of DMG dealt by Asta's Basic ATK at the start of each turn.

4.name: Ignite
4.description: When Asta is on the field, all allies' Fire DMG increases by 18%.

6.name: Constellation
6.description: Asta's DEF increases by 6% for every current Charging stack she possesses.

eidolons.name: Star Sings Sans Verses or Vocals
eidolons.description: When using Skill, deals DMG for 1 extra time to a random enemy.

eidolons.name: Moon Speaks in Wax and Wane
eidolons.description: After using her Ultimate, Asta's Charging stacks will not be reduced in the next turn.

eidolons.name: Meteor Showers for Wish and Want
eidolons.description:
Skill Lv. +2, up to a maximum of Lv. 15.
Talent Lv. +2, up to a maximum of Lv. 15.

eidolons.name: Aurora Basks in Beauty and Bliss
eidolons.description: Asta's Energy Regeneration Rate increases by 15% when she has 2 or more Charging stacks.

eidolons.name: Nebula Secludes in Runes and Riddles
eidolons.description:
Ultimate Lv. +2, up to a maximum of Lv. 15.
Basic ATK Lv. +1, up to a maximum of Lv. 10.

eidolons.name: Cosmos Dreams in Calm and Comfort
eidolons.description: Charging stack(s) lost in each turn is reduced by 1.
